problem: The number of subscribers $S(t)$ to a new video streaming service after $t$ weeks can be modeled by the differential equation ${S}^{′}(t)=0.11S(t).$ If the streaming service had $60\,000$ subscribers after $20$ weeks, calculate the number of subscribers after $32$ weeks.
